data.taxBenefit: Reduced 24% flat income tax rate under the Beckham Law regime for up to 6 years.
requirements: Work remotely for non-Spanish companies (or max 20% income from Spanish clients for freelancers).
Minimum monthly income of EUR 2,646 (200% of Spanish minimum wage).
University degree, professional qualification, or 3 years of work experience.
Clean criminal record for the past 5 years and private health insurance in Spain.

data.taxBenefit: 0% personal income tax on foreign-sourced income.
requirements: Proof of employment with a minimum 1-year contract or proof of company ownership outside the UAE.
Minimum monthly income of $3,500 USD supported by bank statements for the last 3 months.
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity and health insurance covering the UAE.

data.taxBenefit: Access to tax incentives under the IFICI regime for eligible professionals, otherwise subject to standard progressive tax rates.
requirements: Proof of average monthly income equal to at least 4 times the Portuguese minimum wage (EUR 3,280/month)
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or company ownership outside Portugal
Proof of long-term accommodation in Portugal
Valid health insurance coverage and clean criminal record check

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from Japanese personal income tax and residence tax for the 6-month period
requirements: Annual income of at least 10 million JPY or foreign currency equivalent
Private health insurance covering injury, medical treatment, and death in Japan
Passport holder of a tax-treaty and visa-exempt country or region with Japan

data.taxBenefit: Foreign income is exempt from Estonian tax for stays under 183 days per year.
requirements: Minimum gross monthly income of EUR 4,500 during the 6 months prior to applying
Proof of location-independent work (foreign employment contract, owned company, or freelance clients)
Valid health insurance policy for the duration of stay in Estonia
Clean criminal record and valid passport

data.stayDuration: Up to 18 months (Renewable for up to 6 months)
data.taxBenefit: Complete exemption from personal income tax in Croatia on income earned remotely for foreign entities.
requirements: Must be a non-EU/EEA/Swiss national working remotely via communication technology for foreign employers or foreign-registered business
Proof of minimum monthly income of EUR 2,539 (or equivalent in bank savings)
Proof of health insurance covering the territory of Croatia and a valid travel document

data.stayDuration: 3 to 12 months (Renewable up to an additional 12 months)
data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income earned while residing in Malaysia under the pass is exempt from local income tax.
requirements: Minimum annual income of USD 24,000 (or USD 2,000 per month)
Proof of active remote employment contract, freelance contract, or company ownership
Health insurance coverage valid in Malaysia for the duration of stay

data.taxBenefit: 50% tax reduction on salary income exceeding TWD 3 million for up to 5 years
requirements: Must demonstrate professional expertise in one of 10 fields (e.g., Science, Technology, Economy, Finance, Law)
Minimum monthly income of TWD 160,000 in the past 3 years (for salary criteria qualification)
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity

data.stayDuration: 5 Years (up to 180 days per entry, extendable once for 180 days)
data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income is not taxed unless remitted to Thailand during the same calendar year.
requirements: Must be at least 20 years of age
Proof of financial balance of at least 500,000 THB
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or enrollment in approved activities like Muay Thai or Thai culinary courses

data.taxBenefit: 50% personal income tax reduction for up to 7 years when transferring tax residency to Greece
requirements: Proof of monthly net income of at least EUR 3,500 from foreign sources
Proof of employment or business ownership outside Greece with remote capabilities
Clean criminal record from country of residence
Valid health insurance covering medical expenses in Greece

data.taxBenefit: Access to Non-Domicile tax incentives with exemptions on foreign dividends and defense contributions if becoming a tax resident.
requirements: Proof of monthly net income of at least EUR 3,500 from foreign sources
Proof of remote work for foreign-registered employers or personal company
Comprehensive health insurance covering Cyprus
Clean criminal record certificate from residence country

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from local income tax for stays up to 180 days within a 12-month period
requirements: Proof of foreign remote employment, freelancing, or business ownership
Minimum monthly income of 1,000,000 ISK for individual applicants
Valid non-EEA/EFTA passport eligible for visa-free entry to Schengen zone
Comprehensive health insurance covering Iceland

data.processingTime: No visa required prior to entry
data.taxBenefit: Svalbard operates under a distinct low-tax regime with lower income tax rates and no VAT
requirements: Must prove sufficient financial resources to cover high living expenses in Svalbard
Must secure accommodation on the Svalbard archipelago
Valid passport and necessary transit visa for travel through mainland Norway or Schengen area

data.taxBenefit: Eligible for flat tax scheme (Paušální daň) unifying income tax, social security, and health insurance
requirements: Obtain a Czech trade license (Živnostenský list)
Proof of sufficient funds (minimum 156,500 CZK bank balance)
Proof of secured accommodation in the Czech Republic for 1 year
Clean criminal record certificate

data.taxBenefit: Eligible for tax relief under the Italian impatriate tax regime, offering significant income tax reductions for qualified foreign income earners.
requirements: Minimum annual income of EUR 28,000 (approx. EUR 2,333/month) from remote work.
Comprehensive health insurance covering medical treatment and hospitalization in Italy.
Proof of suitable accommodation in Italy and at least 6 months of prior remote work experience.

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from personal income tax and social security contributions if staying less than 183 days in a 12-month period and paying tax abroad.
requirements: Proof of employment or company ownership registered outside Romania for at least 3 months prior to application.
Minimum monthly income equivalent to 3 times the Romanian average gross salary (approx. EUR 3,700/month) for the past 6 months.
Valid international health insurance covering the full visa period with minimum EUR 30,000 coverage.
Clean criminal record certificate and proof of local accommodation in Romania.

data.taxBenefit: 0% personal income tax on foreign-sourced income for certificate holders.
requirements: Proof of continuous remote employment or business ownership outside Bermuda
Demonstration of sufficient financial resources to support yourself
Valid health insurance coverage for Bermuda
Clean criminal record and valid passport

data.taxBenefit: 0% personal income tax on foreign-sourced earnings, capital gains, or wealth.
requirements: Valid passport
Proof of remote employment, freelance work, or virtual study enrollment
Valid health insurance policy covering the Bahamas

data.taxBenefit: Complete exemption from Costa Rican personal income tax on foreign income and exemption from import duties on work equipment.
requirements: Proof of a stable monthly income of at least $3,000 USD ($4,000 USD for families) over the past 12 months
Valid health insurance policy covering all medical expenses in Costa Rica for the duration of stay
Proof of remote work, freelancing, or business ownership outside Costa Rica

data.stayDuration: 1 Year (Renewable for up to 1 additional year)
data.taxBenefit: Tax exemption on foreign income applies for stays under 183 days in a 12-month period; after 183 days, tax residency is established.
requirements: Proof of employment or contract with foreign entities outside Brazil
Minimum monthly income of $1,500 USD or bank balance of $18,000 USD
Valid private health insurance valid in Brazil
Clean criminal background certificate

data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income is not subject to Argentine personal income tax during the temporary residence period.
requirements: Proof of remote work contract, service agreement, or foreign company ownership
Curriculum Vitae (CV) demonstrating relevant professional background
Valid passport with at least 6 months remaining validity
Clean criminal record certificate from country of origin or residence

data.taxBenefit: Foreign income spent via foreign credit or debit cards is not subject to Mauritian income tax
requirements: Proof of remote work, freelancing, or foreign income
Source of income and main business located outside Mauritius
Minimum monthly income of USD 1,500
Valid travel and health insurance coverage

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from local income tax on foreign income if residing in South Africa for less than 183 days in a 12-month period.
requirements: Demonstrate a minimum gross annual income of ZAR 1,000,000 (approx. ZAR 83,333 per month)
Provide proof of foreign employment or non-resident client contracts
Hold valid health insurance covering the entire duration of stay
Submit a medical report, radiological report, and clean police clearance certificates
